Title: Create Contact (lead stand-in) with inline new Account creation; verify default Status/Lifecycle
Preconditions: Logged into Freshsales tenant rakesh-freshsales-ind-sep21.myfreshworks.com as a user with Contacts/Accounts/Deals access (this role has no accessible Leads module, which is expected and out of scope). Run is authorized under authorizations.mode: full-run for this target.
Steps: 1. Navigate to the Contacts module (/crm/sales/contacts). | 2. Click the quick-create "+" icon / "Add contact" to open the Add Contact form. | 3. Enter First Name (e.g. "AgentTest"), Last Name (e.g. "LeadPipeline-<unique>"), Email (unique, e.g. "agenttest.leadpipeline+<unique>@example.com"). | 4. In the Account field, type a new account name (e.g. "AgentTest Pipeline Co <unique>") and select the "Add new account" affordance shown in the typeahead. | 5. Leave Status and Lifecycle stage at their defaults. | 6. Click Save.
ExpectedResult: Contact is created successfully (POST /crm/sales/contacts returns 2xx). A new Account is auto-created (POST /crm/sales/sales_accounts returns 2xx) and linked to the Contact. On the Contact detail page: Status = "New" and Lifecycle stage = "Lead" (tenant may display combined as "New(Lead)"); the Account field shows the newly created account name. Record the new Contact ID and Account ID/name in created-entities.json.
TraceabilityRef: Confirmed behaviors Q1, Q7; In-scope bullets 1 and 3 (clarifications doc)

Title: Advance Contact Status to Qualified; verify Lifecycle stage auto-promotes to Sales Qualified Lead
Preconditions: TC-lead-to-deal-pipeline-001 executed; the Contact exists with Status = New / Lifecycle = Lead.
Steps: 1. Open the Contact detail page for the Contact created in TC-001. | 2. Locate the Status field/pill (pipeline observed: New -> Contacted -> Interested -> Qualified -> Won/Churned). | 3. Change Status to "Qualified". | 4. Save / confirm the change if a save action is required.
ExpectedResult: PUT /crm/sales/contacts/<id> succeeds. Contact Status field now shows "Qualified". Lifecycle stage field auto-updates to "Sales Qualified Lead" without any separate manual edit to that field.

Title: Create a Deal from the qualified Contact/Account on the Default Pipeline
Preconditions: TC-lead-to-deal-pipeline-002 completed; Contact Status = Qualified with a linked Account.
Steps: 1. From the qualified Contact's detail page, click "Add deal". | 2. Enter Deal Name (e.g. "AgentTest Pipeline Deal <unique>"), Amount (e.g. 2500), and confirm Pipeline = "Default Pipeline". | 3. Confirm the Contact and Account from TC-001/002 are pre-linked on the form. | 4. Click Save.
ExpectedResult: POST /crm/sales/deals returns 2xx. A new Deal is created with initial stage "New" on "Default Pipeline". The Deal detail page shows the linked Contact and Account from TC-001/002. Record the new Deal ID in created-entities.json.

Title: Move Deal through full pipeline via stage-pill clicks to Won (New -> Qualification -> Discovery -> Demo -> Negotiation -> Won)
Preconditions: Deal created in TC-lead-to-deal-pipeline-003, currently in stage "New" on the deal detail page (/crm/sales/deals/<id>).
Steps: 1. Open the Deal detail page. | 2. Click the "Qualification" stage pill in the deal-stage progress bar; confirm the "Deal updated" success toast. | 3. Click the "Discovery" pill; confirm toast. | 4. Click the "Demo" pill; confirm toast. | 5. Click the "Negotiation" pill; confirm toast. | 6. Click the "Won" pill (complete any Won-reason/confirmation dialog if prompted); confirm toast.
ExpectedResult: Each click issues a PUT /crm/sales/deals/<id> updating deal_stage_id; each transition shows a "Deal updated" success toast. Final Deal stage displayed = "Won". The Deal appears in the "Won" column on the Deals Kanban board (/crm/sales/deals/view/...).
TraceabilityRef: Edge case #1 (assumption-flagged, Q3); In-scope bullet 4 (clarifications doc)

Title: Move a separate Deal to the Lost stage (alternate terminal branch, distinct from the Won path)
Preconditions: A second Deal, distinct from the one used in TC-004, has been created (repeat TC-001-003 with unique values, or otherwise obtain a fresh Deal this run created) and is in an early stage (e.g. New or Qualification).
Steps: 1. Ensure a fresh Deal (not the TC-004 Deal) exists, per Preconditions. | 2. Open its Deal detail page. | 3. Click the "Lost" stage pill / action in the deal-stage progress bar. | 4. If prompted, select or enter a Lost reason and confirm.
ExpectedResult: PUT /crm/sales/deals/<id> succeeds. Deal stage updates to "Lost". The Deal appears in the "Lost" column/state on the Kanban board and is not also shown as "Won".

Title: Log a Task activity against the Deal
Preconditions: A Deal exists (e.g. the Deal from TC-003/004, in any active stage).
Steps: 1. On the Deal detail page, click "Task" in the top action bar. | 2. Enter a Title (e.g. "Follow up with <Account> on negotiation terms"). | 3. Leave the default due date and owner as pre-filled (owner defaults to the currently logged-in sales user -- during exploration this was "Rakesh M"; confirm at execution time which account is actually logged in, since the automation credentials file may reference a differently-named but equally-capable account). | 4. Click Save.
ExpectedResult: POST /crm/sales/tasks returns 201. The Task appears under the Deal's Activities > Tasks tab; the Tasks count increments by 1; the Task shows the entered title, due date, and owner, and is not completed.
TraceabilityRef: Confirmed behaviors Q5; In-scope bullet 5 (clarifications doc)

Title: (Secondary/optional) Move Deal between Kanban columns via drag-and-drop
Preconditions: A Deal exists and is visible on the Deals Kanban board (/crm/sales/deals/view/...).
Steps: 1. Open the Deals Kanban board. | 2. Locate the Deal's card in its current stage column. | 3. Drag the card and drop it into an adjacent stage column (e.g. from "New" to "Qualification").
ExpectedResult: The Deal's stage updates to match the destination column (PUT /crm/sales/deals/<id> with the updated deal_stage_id); the card renders in the new column after the drop. This case is secondary/nice-to-have per Q4 -- pill-click (TC-004/TC-005) is the primary required interaction; failure of this case alone should not gate the feature as failing.

Title: Contact creation blocked when a required field (Last Name) is left blank
Preconditions: On the Add Contact form (validation-only case; not expected to create a record).
Steps: 1. Open the Add Contact form. | 2. Enter First Name only (e.g. "NoLastName"); leave Last Name blank. | 3. Fill other fields normally, including a valid email. | 4. Click Save.
ExpectedResult: An inline validation error is shown on the Last Name field (e.g. "This field is required"). The form does not submit; no POST /crm/sales/contacts request succeeds (or none is sent); no Contact record is created.

Title: Deal creation blocked when Deal Name is left blank
Preconditions: On the Add Deal form (e.g. via "Add deal" from a Contact or Account; validation-only case).
Steps: 1. Open the Add Deal form. | 2. Leave the Deal Name field blank; fill other fields (Amount, Pipeline) normally. | 3. Click Save.
ExpectedResult: An inline validation error is shown on the Deal Name field. The form does not submit; no POST /crm/sales/deals request succeeds; no Deal record is created.

Title: Inline Account creation blocked when Account Name is left blank
Preconditions: On the Add Contact form, using the inline "Add new account" affordance (validation-only case).
Steps: 1. Open the Add Contact form; fill the required Contact fields. | 2. In the Account field, trigger "Add new account" but leave the new-account Name field blank. | 3. Attempt to confirm the new account and/or submit the Contact form.
ExpectedResult: An inline validation error is shown on the Account Name field. The inline account is not created (no POST /crm/sales/sales_accounts succeeds); the Contact form does not submit while the invalid inline sub-form is open, or the Contact save is blocked pending correction.
TraceabilityRef: Edge case #4; In-scope bullet "Standard field validation coverage on Contact/Account/Deal creation forms" (clarifications doc)

Title: Contact creation blocked with invalid email format
Preconditions: On the Add Contact form (validation-only case).
Steps: 1. Open the Add Contact form; fill First Name and Last Name. | 2. Enter an invalid email format in the Email field (e.g. "not-an-email"). | 3. Click Save.
ExpectedResult: An inline validation error is shown on the Email field (e.g. "Enter a valid email"). The form does not submit; no POST /crm/sales/contacts request succeeds; no Contact record is created.
